Persisted SalesAmount is million IRR; product quantities retain provider units; response layer converts amount to billion toman (value × 0.0001) where that contract applies. Mixed units are flagged.

Quantity uses the row’s Unit. SalesAmount is in million IRR per the owner-supplied definition and trend persistence contract. The line-level SalesRate is a stored source/provider value where present; its implied unit is million IRR per source quantity unit. The separate governed MonthlyAverageSalesRate snapshot is total monthly SalesAmount divided by total SalesQuantity for selected product rows, only when units are not mixed and total quantity is nonzero. It is null when no usable quantity exists. Preserve negative source values; do not substitute the snapshot formula for a source-line SalesRate.
ReportYear/ReportMonth are report month; calendar/fiscal fields are separate. CalculatedAtUtc is not report period end.
